content.user_title: Research Web and Code Context with Exa
content.value_statement: Technical research often needs current articles, documentation, and working examples from many sources. This skill provides Exa-based workflows for web research, code discovery, comparison, and query refinement.
actual_capabilities: Guides Exa web searches for articles, documentation, news, and product comparisons.
Guides Exa code searches for examples, APIs, framework patterns, and implementation references.
Provides workflows for technology research, implementation research, comparison research, and discovery research.
Includes helper scripts for multi-step research workflows and query optimization.
Suggests query patterns, result validation steps, and parameter choices for deeper searches.
limitations: Requires configured Exa tools and an Exa API key outside the skill.
Search quality depends on source availability, freshness, and query wording.
It provides research guidance, not guaranteed factual verification or legal advice.
Helper scripts rely on the surrounding project path and Exa server imports.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a New Framework
use_cases.description: Research current features, adoption signals, documentation, and starter examples before choosing a technical path.

use_cases.title: Compare Developer Tools
use_cases.description: Collect comparison articles, product updates, and implementation examples for a balanced tool selection review.

use_cases.title: Build an Implementation Brief
use_cases.description: Gather authoritative explanations and practical examples to create an accurate guide or internal note.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Current Overview
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Exa Research to find a current overview of [topic]. Summarize the main concepts, recent updates, and reliable sources.

prompt_templates.title: Research an Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Exa Research to learn how to implement [feature] in [framework]. Include guides, common patterns, and working examples.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Exa Research to compare [option A] and [option B]. Cover strengths, tradeoffs, recent changes, and implementation evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Research Dossier
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Exa Research to build a sourced dossier on [topic]. Combine web results, code examples, source quality notes, and open questions.

output_examples.input: Research Next.js 15 server features for a planning meeting.
output_examples.output: A concise brief with current feature summaries, source links to documentation and articles, practical implementation notes, and follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: Compare Cursor and GitHub Copilot for a development team.
output_examples.output: A balanced comparison covering capabilities, recent updates, pricing signals, workflow fit, and evidence from product pages and user reports.

output_examples.input: Find examples for adding authentication to a FastAPI service.
output_examples.output: A research summary with relevant guides, common authentication patterns, implementation references, and risks to validate before adoption.

best_practices: Start broad, then refine queries after reviewing the first results.
Use both web and code search when researching technical implementation choices.
Validate important claims across multiple current and authoritative sources.
anti_patterns: Using single-word queries that return broad and low-value results.
Trusting one search result without checking date, source quality, or context.
Requesting large code context when a focused example would answer the question.

faq.question: What does this skill help me research?
faq.answer: It helps research technologies, tools, implementation patterns, current updates, and code examples using Exa search capabilities.

faq.question: Does it require an Exa API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The Exa tools must be configured separately with an API key before the workflows can run.

faq.question: Can it find code examples?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents the Exa code context tool for finding implementation examples, API usage, and framework patterns.

faq.question: Can it verify that every result is true?
faq.answer: No. It supports research and source collection, but users must validate important claims against trusted sources.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is useful for engineers, technical writers, product builders, and AI agents that need current technical research.

faq.question: Does the skill execute shell commands?
faq.answer: The reviewed SKILL.md content contains documentation examples, not shell execution instructions. Helper scripts run only when a user invokes them.
